topic: Berkshire Hathaway turned $1,000 into roughly $30 million since 1965 -- at "only" about 20% a year, compounded
title: How 'Only' 20% a Year Became $30 Million
description:
Most people chase lottery-ticket stocks that promise to 100x overnight. But one of the greatest investment track records in history came from 'only' about 20% annual returns.
